title: Policy-Driven Organizational Synthesis (PDOS)
description: Policy-Driven Organizational Synthesis (PDOS) is a computational framework for synthesizing, exploiting, and continuously evolving organizational structures under explicit policies. The repository develops a unified architecture connecting organizational intelligence, organizational routing, runtime computation, localized runtime intelligence, continuous learning, Brain Units, multi-policy runtime intelligence, and closed-loop organizational evolution. Version 1.0 establishes the first complete theoretical foundation of PDOS across five progressively connected parts: Foundations; From Knowledge Organization to Triggering Economy; Policy-Driven Runtime Architecture; Toward Organizational Intelligence; and Localized Runtime Intelligence.
notes: Version 1.0 establishes the first complete theoretical and engineering foundation of Policy-Driven Organizational Synthesis (PDOS). The release integrates five progressively connected parts covering foundational organizational principles, the Triggering Economy, policy-driven runtime architecture, Organizational Intelligence, and Localized Runtime Intelligence.
